returns 99,999,999 (`0x5F5E0FF`) when `ecx` is above it (signed) and 0 when `ecx` is negative; otherwise picks `edx` when `ecx + edx` is non-negative and `ecx` itself when that sum is negative, and returns the pick unless `ecx` plus the pick exceeds 99,999,999 (signed), in which case it returns 99,999,999 minus `ecx`

uses `ecx` as an index (replaced by 0 after a call to `0016D6A0(0x200)` when above `0xB` unsigned, once for each of its two uses); resolves dword `+4` of the 8-byte entry at `02092760` through `0020E600` and scans the number of words given by dword `+0x47B8` of qword `020927C0` plus 4 times the index for one equal to `edx` shifted right by 16; the first match is overwritten with `0xFFFF` and followed by `002534C0` with the original `ecx` (not the clamped index), while no match or a count of 0 or less returns without either
